headline: Portfolio Outperforms SPY YTD
summary: As of July 14, 2026, the portfolio set has achieved an average return of 18.44%, significantly outperforming the SPY benchmark return of 10.96%. This results in an average alpha of 7.48%, indicating that the portfolios are not only rising in absolute terms but also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A', has delivered an impressive return of 46.90%, contributing a dollar change of $468.96. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Google 100', has returned 10.88%, which is still above the SPY but less impactful. This outperformance is particularly notable during a period characterized by macro uncertainty and market volatility. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
